1	/** Configuration resolution for deterministic tool-result pruning. */
2	
3	import { deepFreeze } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-values'
4	import type { ResolvedConfig, ToolResultPruneConfig } from './types.ts'
5	
6	/** Fixed marker substituted for every removed middle span. */
7	export const PRUNE_MARKER = '\n\n[... tool result middle pruned ...]\n\n'
8	
9	/** Low-friction defaults for coding-agent tool output. */
10	export const DEFAULTS: ResolvedConfig = deepFreeze({
11	  thresholdChars: 8192,
12	  headChars: 4096,
13	  tailChars: 1024,
14	})
15	
16	const CONFIG_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
17	  'thresholdChars',
18	  'headChars',
19	  'tailChars',
20	])
21	
22	/**
23	 * Count Unicode code points without splitting surrogate pairs.
24	 * @param text - text to measure.
25	 * @returns the Unicode code-point count.
26	 */
27	export function codePointLength(text: string): number {
28	  return Array.from(text).length
29	}
30	
31	/**
32	 * Resolve and validate pruning budgets.
33	 * @param config - raw plugin configuration.
34	 * @returns a detached deeply immutable configuration.
35	 */
36	export function resolveConfig(config: ToolResultPruneConfig = {}): ResolvedConfig {
37	  for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {
38	    if (!CONFIG_KEYS.has(key)) {
39	      throw new Error(
40	        `ToolResultPruneConfig: unknown key "${key}" `
41	        + '(allowed: thresholdChars, headChars, tailChars)',
42	      )
43	    }
44	  }
45	
46	  const resolved: ResolvedConfig = {
47	    thresholdChars: config.thresholdChars ?? DEFAULTS.thresholdChars,
48	    headChars: config.headChars ?? DEFAULTS.headChars,
49	    tailChars: config.tailChars ?? DEFAULTS.tailChars,
50	  }
51	  assertPositiveInteger('thresholdChars', resolved.thresholdChars)
52	  assertNonNegativeInteger('headChars', resolved.headChars)
53	  assertNonNegativeInteger('tailChars', resolved.tailChars)
54	
55	  const emittedChars = resolved.headChars
56	    + codePointLength(PRUNE_MARKER)
57	    + resolved.tailChars
58	  if (emittedChars > resolved.thresholdChars) {
59	    throw new Error(
60	      `ToolResultPruneConfig: headChars + marker + tailChars (${emittedChars}) `
61	      + `must be at most thresholdChars (${resolved.thresholdChars})`,
62	    )
63	  }
64	  return deepFreeze(structuredClone(resolved))
65	}
66	
67	function assertPositiveInteger(name: string, value: number): void {
68	  if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
69	    throw new Error(`ToolResultPruneConfig: ${name} (${value}) must be a positive integer`)
70	  }
71	}
72	
73	function assertNonNegativeInteger(name: string, value: number): void {
74	  if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0) {
75	    throw new Error(`ToolResultPruneConfig: ${name} (${value}) must be a non-negative integer`)
76	  }
77	}
78

1	import type { ToolCallId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
2	
3	/** Character-budget policy for deterministic tool-result pruning. */
4	export interface ToolResultPruneConfig {
5	  /** Prune when total text exceeds this many Unicode code points. Defaults to `8192`. */
6	  thresholdChars?: number
7	  /** Maximum leading Unicode code points retained. Defaults to `4096`. */
8	  headChars?: number
9	  /** Maximum trailing Unicode code points retained. Defaults to `1024`. */
10	  tailChars?: number
11	}
12	
13	/** Validated, detached, deeply immutable pruning configuration. */
14	export interface ResolvedConfig {
15	  readonly thresholdChars: number
16	  readonly headChars: number
17	  readonly tailChars: number
18	}
19	
20	/** Cited source event and size accounting for one landed surface replacement. */
21	export interface PrunedEntry {
22	  /** Full-fidelity tool-result event shadowed by the replacement. */
23	  readonly originalSeq: number
24	  /** Newly appended pruned tool-result event. */
25	  readonly replacementSeq: number
26	  /** Tool call shared by the original and replacement. */
27	  readonly callId: ToolCallId
28	  /** Original text size in Unicode code points. */
29	  readonly charsBefore: number
30	  /** Replacement text size in Unicode code points. */
31	  readonly charsAfter: number
32	}
33	
34	/** Aggregate outcome of one stable-surface pruning pass. */
35	export interface PruneResult {
36	  /** Replacements in the snapshotted surface order. */
37	  readonly pruned: readonly PrunedEntry[]
38	  /** Total Unicode code points removed across replacements. */
39	  readonly charsRemoved: number
40	}

1	/**
2	 * Vocabulary for the spill storage Service Definition. Types only — the abstract service
3	 * lives in `./index.ts`, implementations in sibling packages
4	 * (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-spill-local` first).
5	 *
6	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-spill/types
7	 */
8	
9	import type { Branded } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand'
10	import type { ToolCallId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
11	import type { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
12	
13	/**
14	 * Opaque model-facing handle for one spilled artifact. A local backend may use a
15	 * filesystem path; a remote or database backend may use a URI or key. Consumers
16	 * render it with {@link SpillRef.retrievalHint}, but do not parse it.
17	 */
18	export type SpillLocator = Branded<'SpillLocator'>
19	
20	/**
21	 * Brand a string as a {@link SpillLocator}.
22	 *
23	 * @param locator The backend-produced locator string to brand.
24	 * @returns The branded spill locator.
25	 */
26	export function SpillLocator(locator: string): SpillLocator {
27	  return locator as SpillLocator
28	}
29	
30	/**
31	 * Save-time storage namespace for a spilled artifact. The session id lets a
32	 * backend group storage under the producing session, but the returned
33	 * {@link SpillLocator} is the model-facing handle. Forked sessions inherit
34	 * locators already present in the seeded log; those artifacts are not copied or
35	 * re-owned, and spills produced after the fork use the child session id.
36	 */
37	export interface SpillOwner {
38	  sessionId: SessionId
39	}
40	
41	/**
42	 * Tool and call that produced one spilled artifact — recorded by the backend for a readable
43	 * filename and inspection. Not interpreted for access control; purely
44	 * descriptive.
45	 */
46	export interface SpillSource {
47	  /** The tool whose result was spilled (e.g. `web_fetch`). */
48	  toolName: string
49	  /** The model-issued call id the result belongs to. */
50	  callId: ToolCallId
51	  /** A short human label for the artifact (e.g. `result`). */
52	  label: string
53	}
54	
55	/** One request to persist text to a spill artifact. */
56	export interface SaveTextSpill {
57	  owner: SpillOwner
58	  source: SpillSource
59	  /**
60	   * A caller-suggested base name (e.g. `web_fetch.txt`). The backend sanitizes
61	   * it to a single safe path segment before use — it is a hint, never a path.
62	   */
63	  suggestedName: string
64	  /** The full text to persist (UTF-8). */
65	  content: string
66	}
67	
68	/** A saved spill artifact: its locator, byte length, and backend-specific retrieval guidance. */
69	export interface SpillRef {
70	  locator: SpillLocator
71	  bytes: number
72	  retrievalHint: string
73	}

1	/**
2	 * Package-owned invariant companion for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner`.
3	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner/invariant
4	 */
5	
6	/* jscpd:ignore-start */
7	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
8	import type { InvariantInstaller } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants'
9	
10	const PACKAGE_NAME = '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
11	
12	/** Cordis companion plugin name. */
13	export const name = 'compaction-tool-result-pruner-invariant'
14	/** Services required before the companion can register. */
15	export const inject = ['invariants']
16	
17	/** No runtime invariant: Session validates each content-only rewrite and its companion owns cross-event enclosure. */
18	const install: InvariantInstaller = () => {}
19	
20	/**
21	 * Register this package's invariant companion.
22	 * @param ctx - Cordis context carrying the invariant service.
23	 * @returns the installed registration's disposer after setup succeeds.
24	 */
25	export const apply = (ctx: Context): Promise<() => void> =>
26	  Promise.resolve(ctx.invariants.register(PACKAGE_NAME, install))
27	/* jscpd:ignore-end */
